Request a Free Quote! Welcome to EAV Construction — Custom Pool Builder & General Contractor in the Dallas Metroplex EAV Construction is a trusted pool builder and pool remodeling company proudly serving Garland, Dallas, Richardson, Rockwall, Rowlett, and Royse City, as well as the greater Dallas Metroplex. With over 20 years of experience, our family-owned and operated business specializes in custom pool design, new pool construction, and pool renovations that elevate your outdoor living space. Our team creates beautiful inground pools with craftsmanship, innovative design, and quality materials. Whether you're dreaming of a new pool build, a modern pool remodel, or a complete home improvement project, EAV Construction delivers expertise, reliability, and customer satisfaction, bringing your vision to life across North Texas. Custom Pools Learn More Pool Remodels Learn More Concrete Work Learn More Apartment Property Solutions Learn More Why Choose Us? A Message from Our Owner ​ "When you work with EAV Construction, you work directly with me. I’m personally involved in every project, from the initial design consultation to the final walkthrough, because I believe every client deserves clear communication, hands-on attention, and care throughout the entire process. My goal is to ensure every detail reflects our commitment to quality craftsmanship, thoughtful planning, and lasting value. With owner oversight every step of the way, our clients can trust their project is in capable, caring hands." ​ -Erik Velasquez, Owner & Founder Customized Solutions We deliver customized & specific solutions that align with each client’s vision to achieve exceptional, efficient, and high-quality results. Artisanal Craftsmanship Artisanal craftsmanship is at the heart of every project, ensuring quality, durability, and meticulous attention to detail. Client-Driven Approach We place you at the center of every decision, creating solutions that bring your vision to life. Owner Oversight Experience the difference of a company where the owner personally cares & oversees every project from the initial design to completion. Exclusive Pool Deal! Starting at $69,500! 8-12 Week Build Time, Just In Time For Summer! Transform your backyard with our premium 24x12' pools starting at an unbeatable price of $69,500! Each pool comes equipped with 2 LED lights, smart controls, elegant white plaster, coping, and 300 sq ft of decking. Enjoy a swift 8-12 week build time, and dive into luxury and relaxation in no time. Don't miss out on this exclusive offer! Get Offer! Client Reviews Arielle Nabors We have been working with EAV Construction since May 2025 to replace our driveway and add a concrete slab for a shed next to our house. Additionally, they added landscaping gravel on both sides of the driveway. We have been so happy with all of the work they've done in the past and continue to do presently. EAV will be our go-to for any house related construction or repair needs. Jesus Rosas Erik and his team did our back driveway and completely exceeded our expectations! He constantly stayed in communication throughout the whole project from start to finish. EAV Construction goes above and beyond with any project you might have in mind. Kaylie McCrory Erik and his team were absolutely amazing! I called him on a very long shot to see if he could come install an above ground pool for me. He came out, gave me a quote, and it was completed in a matter of a couple days. I HIGHLY recommend him for any outdoor/exterior projects. He even gave me ideas on building an inground pool, which I will eventually take him up on. He is very professional, priced competitively and is local to Garland. I will be telling everyone I know about his company. Thank you again, Erik, for making my little families summer a little bit more cooler. We will be in touch soon.
